name: NoVACoupleTVFilmingLocation

custom.system_prompt: Life-first evening at home. Nora and Alex are watching a film or series. A location on screen looks familiar. They debate where it is through their own conversation and resolve the question without asking Sigma.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet evening living room with a television playing softly, occasional muffled dialogue and ambient outdoor sounds from the programme, cups on a table, sofa shifting, subtle household ambience.

initial_prompt: Generate a long, natural conversation between Nora and Alex during an evening film or series. A location on screen looks familiar — they debate where it is. They speculate, disagree, move to personal topics including a travel memory, and return to the location question when it reappears on screen. This time the question resolves without Sigma: a title card names the city, one person recognises a specific landmark, they read a sign in the background, or they agree it does not matter. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Nora
user1.tts_prompt: Observant, warm, conversational, dry sense of humour

user2.name: Alex
user2.tts_prompt: Relaxed, reflective, mildly distractible, natural speech

variations.context: A couple watching a drama or film with a recognisable exterior location. They identify it through their own observations, without Sigma.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Nora notices details. Alex makes confident geographic guesses. They compare the location to places they have visited.
setting.background: The programme is well into its run when a distinctive exterior appears.
setting.conversation_style: Life-first domestic conversation. The location thread surfaces, disappears, and resolves through human means.

user1.name: Nora
user1.role: Partner. Notices architectural details. Resolves the location question through visual observation or accepts uncertainty — does not ask Sigma.

user2.name: Alex
user2.role: Partner. Confident about geography, often wrong. Satisfied when the answer comes from any source.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Location thread must surface, disappear into personal topics, and return before resolving.
At least half the turns should concern personal life.
Resolution must occur without Sigma, through natural means only.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
At least 50% of turns should be independent of the location question.
